scope: Final validator-only reduction-order erratum. The one sealed v239 formal output is not rerun; no scientific array, candidate, rank, fold, tail, gate, control, or decision rule changes.

prior_fail_closed_attempts.failure: independent inverse diagonal SHA differed from the formal sum-reduction SHA
independent absolute floor differed from the formal scalar by one floating reduction-order ulp

immutable_formal.formal_directory_role: The sole completed v239 formal output; every file is read-only and must remain byte-identical.

single_correction.formal_rule: The sealed formal build remains required to match all v235 Jacobi hashes exactly.
single_correction.independent_rule: The independent einsum reduction records, but does not gate on, scalar-floor or array hash bit identity. It must retain exact rig/camera identity, positive finite values, camera-permutation invariance, and after all direct-SVD residuals are complete it must match the sealed formal inverse diagonal under the original 1e-10 relative tolerance.
single_correction.absolute_floor_audit: Record every independent and sealed formal floor and require the thirteen-rig maximum relative difference to be at most 1e-10.
forbidden_changes: changing rank 64, leave-one-rig folds, tails, centering, normalization, or weighting
changing all-frame or late-frame p90/worst gates
reading formal residual arrays before independent direct-SVD residuals are complete
adding any candidate, predictor, model, GPU run, or resource claim

decision_boundary: A successful v239.2 run may only validate the existing pending v239 decision. Any remaining mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE and cannot authorize scientific retuning.
